processes.name: Inspect vertex form: vertex (h, k) including plus-inside, axis x = h, maximum or minimum from the sign of a
Expand vertex form into standard form and verify equivalent representations
Describe what can be read from vertex form compared with standard form and factored form, without producing those other writings
Find zeros of a given vertex-form equation by inverse operations only (no quadratic formula, no completing the square)
Construct a vertex-form equation from a vertex plus another point (or stated constraints), and say what remains free if only the vertex is known
Predict from the equation what changing one of a, h, or k will do to the graph, then check that prediction against the graph and the rewritten equation

candidates.title: Name the vertex when the brackets show a plus
candidates.purpose: Minds On diagnostic: commit to a vertex from a plus-inside equation before the graph. Not the inspect partial cell — that cell is error-diagnosis.

candidates.title: Vertex and maximum from a negative a
candidates.purpose: Worked inspection: vertex, axis, and maximum from the sign of a, including matching (x + 2) to (x − h).

candidates.title: Maximum when k is zero
candidates.purpose: Varied inspection: k = 0 so maximum versus minimum cannot be taken from k.

candidates.title: First invalid step: reading +3 as h = 3
candidates.purpose: Assembled error-diagnosis (not drawer-only). Partial slot for inspect-vertex-form: locate and repair the h-sign error. Folded from assembly process diagnose-vertex-errors.

candidates.title: Test the claim that the axis is y = h
candidates.purpose: Assembled claim-testing (not drawer-only). Independent/transfer of inspect-vertex-form: prove, qualify, or refute the axis-as-y claim. Folded from assembly process diagnose-vertex-errors.

candidates.title: First invalid step: maximum from the sign of k
candidates.purpose: Drawer: k-versus-a max/min error. Same misconception as vf-k-zero-maximum; extra diagnosis only.

candidates.title: Domain and range from vertex form
candidates.purpose: Drawer: domain and range from vertex form. A2.3 already taught; extra retrieval only.

candidates.title: Predict a horizontal shift from h
candidates.purpose: Action predict–move–check beat. Independent one-parameter h change after the vertex board has taught predict/check. No second paper fade.

candidates.title: Expand ½(x + 2)^2 − 3
candidates.purpose: Worked expansion of ½(x + 2)² − 3 with a two-value check. Table values corroborate; they do not prove identity.

candidates.title: Ministry sample: expand 3(x − 1)^2 + 4
candidates.purpose: Independent A2.7 sample after the expand-same-graph board. Authored expansion, not a Ministry key.

candidates.title: Choose how to check that two writings are the same curve
candidates.purpose: Assembled method-choice (not drawer-only). Transfer of expand-and-verify: algebra versus a graph under “prove they are the same function for every x.” Not a three-form-contrast cell.

candidates.title: Why matching table values do not prove identity
candidates.purpose: Assembled claim-testing (not drawer-only). Retrieval/transfer of expand-and-verify: a finite table corroborates, it does not prove identity.

candidates.title: First invalid step in an expansion
candidates.purpose: Assembled error-diagnosis (not drawer-only). Partial slot for expand-and-verify: repair a binomial-square distribution error. Folded from assembly process diagnose-vertex-errors.

candidates.title: Same curve, two writings
candidates.purpose: Drawer: same identity as the worked expand plus readable-features contrast. Not a second assembled expand drill.

candidates.title: What vertex form makes readable
candidates.purpose: Worked contrast: what vertex form makes readable versus standard form, without producing another writing.

candidates.title: Defend a form for a stated decision
candidates.purpose: Assembled method-choice recipe on form-affordances (not drawer-only). Compact variation and independent: defend vertex form for a highest-point decision, not intercepts.

candidates.title: Zeros from vertex form by inverse operations
candidates.purpose: Compact worked and independent zeros: undo operations (both signs). No quadratic formula. Same assembled stem serves both fade cells.

candidates.title: Choose a method for zeros of a vertex-form equation
candidates.purpose: Drawer: extra method-choice on zeros. Director beat names this stem; assembly keeps it off the page so the page is not a dump of every method-choice item. Richness family method-choice is already assembled via vf-method-equivalence and vf-form-choice-defend.

candidates.title: Recover a from a vertex and another point
candidates.purpose: Worked construction: recover a from vertex plus a point; uniqueness is asked in the stem.

candidates.title: Map a labelled graph to vertex form
candidates.purpose: Variation: labelled graph features mapped to a, h, and k. Representation-bridge on the page.

candidates.title: Two vertex forms with the same turning point
candidates.purpose: Assembled constraint-construction (not drawer-only). Compact independent and retrieval: two different writings with the same vertex.

candidates.title: What remains free if you only know the vertex
candidates.purpose: Drawer: degrees of freedom when only the vertex is known. Director wanted this as assembled partial/independent; assembly keeps it drawer because uniqueness is already inside vf-vertex-and-point.

candidates.title: Vertex, opening, and a point: is a unique?
candidates.purpose: Drawer: extra uniqueness variant (opening constrained plus a point).

candidates.title: Match vertex-form features to a table
candidates.purpose: Drawer: table-to-vertex-form bridge. Graph bridge is on the page. Folded from assembly seed process inspect-vertex-form into construct-from-constraints (director representation-bridge beat).

candidates.title: Read a new downward-opening vertex form
candidates.purpose: Consolidation retrieval of inspection plus A2.7 awareness (expanding does not move the curve). Same situation family as the hook equation, not a predict-parameter paper fade.

candidates.title: Read a maximum without completing the square
candidates.purpose: Consolidation retrieval of a maximum from a given vertex-form model (maximum-from-representations). Hook is situation-only; do not solve this item in Minds On. Folded from assembly process interpret-context-vertex. Authored solution uses Search / Translate / Answer / Review plus a diagram — teacher-only structure, not student-facing labels.

candidates.title: Meaningful domain of a rising-then-falling model
candidates.purpose: Consolidation model-critique of a given vertex-form height model (original stream, not A3.3). Retrieval of zeros-from-vertex-form via landing zeros, then a meaningful domain. Folded from assembly process interpret-context-vertex. Authored solution uses Search / Translate / Answer / Review plus a diagram — teacher-only structure, not student-facing labels.

candidates.title: Nelson bank items (internal only)
candidates.purpose: Nelson 4.1 bank stays internal. Do not export Functions 11 wording or crops.
candidates.exclusion_reason: Restricted pending reuse rights. Do not export source wording or crops. Use original prompts in accepted records instead.

candidates.title: MathNet 0gz2 olympiad stem
candidates.purpose: MathNet contest stem is not classroom copy.
candidates.exclusion_reason: Olympiad difficulty; contest stem is not classroom copy. Convenience key unverified.

candidates.title: Historical data-fitting (out of scope)
candidates.purpose: Regression / historical table is out of L1 scope. Recorded exception, not a quota filler. data-modelling stays off the student page.
candidates.exclusion_reason: Q15-style data fitting is labelled historical and out of this lesson’s approved scope. Recorded as a coverage exception, not a quota filler.
